title: Movement and Regulation of Petrol Pump Prices
what_it_is: Movement and Regulation of Petrol Pump Prices

sections.label: Petrol pricing uses MOPS
sections.summary: CCS found petrol companies use Mean of Platts Singapore prices, not crude oil prices, in cost accounting and retail petrol pricing.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: CCS found that the petrol companies use Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS) prices, not crude oil prices, in their cost accounting and pricing decisions for retail petrol.

sections.label: Petrol price pass-through 2014-2016
sections.summary: Between June 2014 and January 2016, crude oil, MOPS and Octane 95 prices fell, with effective consumer price pass-through over 85%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Between June 2014 and January 2016, crude oil price fell by an average of S$0.59, MOPS price fell by S$0.52 and the listed price for Octane 95 petrol fell by S$0.35.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: After taking into account the discounts and rebates that consumers enjoy and the levy increase in February 2015, the effective price that consumers paid for Octane 95 petrol fell by S$0.45, implying a pass-through of over 85%.

sections.label: No evidence of petrol collusion
sections.summary: Based on information gathered, there is no evidence of collusion in retail petrol pricing, though petrol companies monitor and react to each other's published prices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Based on the information gathered, there is no evidence, Mdm Speaker, to suggest collusion in retail petrol pricing, even though petrol companies do monitor and react to one another's published prices.

sections.label: Petrol companies' operating income
sections.summary: Petrol companies' operating income per litre has generally increased over past years, but less than the increase in non-fuel components.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The question of whether the petrol companies' prices will go up and how much the increase in petrol prices are affecting the operating income of the companies, for example, in terms of the profit margins that the Member was alluding to, on average, on a per litre basis, the operating income of petrol companies has generally increased over the past few years, but the increase is smaller relative to the increase in the non-fuel components that the companies have to shoulder.

sections.label: 2014 Octane 95 discounts
sections.summary: In 2014, consumers enjoyed an average of about 18% discounts and rebates off retail Octane 95 petrol prices.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In 2014, consumers enjoyed an average of about 18% discounts and rebates off the retail petrol prices for Octane 95.

sections.label: CCS petrol demand survey
sections.summary: CCS will survey petrol demand in Singapore to understand consumer choices and switching behaviour, including whether price transparency facilitates a more competitive market.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: CCS will be conducting a customer survey on petrol demand in Singapore to understand consumer choices and their switching behaviour on petrol purchases, in particular, whether improving price 	Page: 11 transparency will facilitate a more competitive market.

sections.label: Petrol pricing and MOPS
sections.summary: Petrol pricing's key variation in response to market crude oil prices is MOPS pricing, which has been consistent with other companies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As far as the pricing of petrol is concerned for which the key variation in response to market crude oil prices is the MOPS pricing, that has been consistent with all the other companies.

sections.label: MOPS as pricing benchmark
sections.summary: MOPS is a price on which oil is traded in Singapore and the region, and is a key pricing benchmark.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The MOPS price is a price on which oil is traded in Singapore and the region.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For example, Australia imports wholesale petrol from Singapore based on MOPS price, which is a key pricing benchmark.

sections.label: No significant price difference
sections.summary: On average, there was no significance between the prices, whether on the rise or decline.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: On average, there was no significance between the prices, whether it was on the rise or on the decline.
